changes.after:
Astra Chain – Stainless steel satellite chain dotted with tiny bead stations. Adjustable extender for a comfortable fit. Lightweight, nickel-free, and resistant to rust and tarnish. Smooth finish suitable for everyday wear and effortless layering.

Features:

  • Type: Celestial Pendant Chain Necklace
  • Material: Premium high-grade metal alloy base plated in a rich, high-shine golden finish, accented with glossy black enamel inlay and hand-set round crimson-red zirconia crystals.
  • Design: A refined, minimalist neckline silhouette featuring a slender oval cable-link chain suspending a tapered bail and a bevel-edged rectangular black enamel tablet pendant embellished with a sculpted crescent moon, a crystal-centered four-point starburst, twin red crystal dots, and tiny golden stars.
  • Aesthetic: Contemporary Chic, Celestial Elegance, Crescent & Starlight Splendor, Royal Heritage Charm
  • Chain Length: 17 inches
  • Size: Adjustable
  • Weight: 15 grams
  • What's in the Box: 1 x Chain Necklace
  • Packaging: Packed in a secure air-tight pouch and an elegant Zeesy Jewellery signature branded box.

Care Instructions: To maintain the beautiful shine of your jewelry, gently wipe it with a soft cloth after each wear. Avoid contact with water, harsh chemicals, or excessive moisture to preserve the piece's function and plating.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: What occasions is this chain suitable for?

A: This chain is ideal for daily wear, office styling, casual outings, and thoughtful gifting. Its dainty celestial crescent-and-star pendant design wears effortlessly solo or layered with other fine chains.

Q2: What outfit styles pair best with this chain?

A: The lustrous golden finish, sleek black enamel tablet pendant, and sparkling crimson crystal accents complement casual kurtis, formal Western attire, and chic fusion wear effortlessly.

Q3: What is this piece made of, and is it skin-friendly?

A: It is crafted from a premium high-grade metal alloy base and finished with careful attention to detail. Designed for comfortable wear, the materials are selected to be gentle on the skin for most wearers during regular use.

Q4: What makes the design of this chain unique?

A: It features a graceful celestial-couture layout pairing a slender golden cable chain with a black enamel rectangular charm detailed with a textured crescent moon, red-gemstone four-point star, and scattered starlight motifs.

Q5: What is the delivery time and authenticity guarantee?

A: Delivery across Pakistan takes 3-5 working days. Every Zeesy piece is quality-checked to ensure premium craftsmanship and brand authenticity.
